svg.text: monitoring + tracing · co-located on c360-api-uat-api (10.100.1.5) · Keycloak-SSO-gated (L4 LB can’t do OIDC)
⚠ Ops tools use the LB IP, not beta.leocdp.com. leocdp.com is HSTS-preloaded (includeSubDomains), so browsers force
valid-cert HTTPS on the whole host & every port — breaking the plain-HTTP (:3000 Dagster, :19999 Netdata, :5050 pgAdmin) and
self-signed (:9443 Portainer) ops ports. Reach them at http(s)://103.245.254.29:<port>. Only the :443 Caddy front door has a
trusted cert. Jaeger is the exception: fronted by Caddy at https://beta.leocdp.com/jaeger (SSO, TLS).
auxiliary: SSO · introspect · traces · ops · optional
Caddy reverse proxy · :443/:80 · TLS termination (auto Let’s Encrypt) + path routing
/ → frontend /c360api → api /auth → keycloak /ads → ads /data → tracking /jaeger → oauth2 (SSO)
tracking NDJSON sink · TF remote state leocdp360-tfstate
